note: A translated template variable stops being a variable. It renders as Russian words where a name should be.
input: Translate to Russian: Hello {{first_name}}, your subscription renews on {{renews_on}}.

note: Translating a product name produces a name the customer cannot find anywhere in the product.
input: Translate to Russian: Open Omniflow and choose the Annual plan.

note: Links never reach a model — the redactor replaces every URL before the request leaves. What has to survive translation is the placeholder, because the caller substitutes the real link back afterwards, and a translated or dropped placeholder means the customer gets a message with no link in it.
input: Translate to Russian: See the guide at [SUBSCRIPTION_LINK] for the setup steps.

note: Translation is translation. A model that helpfully answers the question instead has changed what the operator is sending.
